verdict_summary: R0 baseline review confirmed 5 defects via isolated probes (P01-P05) and verified the C10 validator failure / checks contradiction. The baseline cannot be approved. Acceptance contracts and benchmarks are frozen for Developer iteration starting with R01.

checks_record.checked_attributes: 9 caller pre-sampled temperature accuracy checks against analytical reference

c10_committed_response_audit.contradiction_finding: The previous acceptance runner recorded case C10 as PASS based solely on caller pre-sampled temperature checks, completely disregarding the actual validate.solution tool response which returned isError=True, numerical_verification_status=FAIL, and status=FAIL. Numerical fixture accuracy was conflated with validator product success.

probes.detail: Gateway add_tool indiscriminately flattens arguments dict, stripping the outer arguments wrapper required by registry_call/operation_call.
Gateway flattens arguments dictionary for code.execute_java, corrupting Map parameters passed to Java tasks.
Gateway uses dict.setdefault on already bound None values, failing to replace them with wrapped arguments.
Applying assess_validator_response to C10 actual response fails because numerical_verification_status is FAIL and isError is True.
Operations starting with validate.* or matching plot.* bypass configured isolation checks regardless of actual side effects.

findings_baseline.title: Transient acceptance marks validator failure as PASS (C10 contradiction)
Isolation and model binding regression (ledger[0] fallback, revision rewrite, name exemptions)
Global arguments flattening breaks registry_call, operation_call, code.execute_java
Observations caller-supplied without model validation loop; lack of ObservationRef verification
Convergence studies using fixed lists instead of actual mesh/time solves
Missing readback masked by defaults (79.999...W fallback, synthetic UUIDs)
Validate report non-atomic publishing, bool string parsing bug, lack of ArtifactStore
Structure and convergence validation checks incomplete (tag-only, caller errors accepted)
Run identity, raw evidence, and progress summaries non-converged

criteria_for_developer_round_r01.focus: M1: Model, Revision, Isolation & Argument Normalization (Addressing F02, F03, T03, T04, T05)

required_fixes.rule: Remove ledger[0] fallback. Must require explicit ModelRef or unambiguous, server-side authorized binding. Reject ambiguous models.
Never silently rewrite expired ModelRef/revision to current revision. Mutating and evaluation actions must strictly validate revision; read-only operations may have explicit unversioned contracts.
Eliminate name-based exemptions (validate.*, plot.*). Gate isolation by true operation effect (read vs evaluate vs mutate vs render).

Scope argument flattening strictly to declared W20 compatibility schemas. Retain nested arguments dict for registry_call and operation_call. Retain Map argument for code.execute_java. Distinguish None from missing fields. Refuse conflicting wrappers or unsupported arguments.

developer_deliverables_for_r01: Unit and integration tests covering P01-P03, P05, conflicting wrappers, and model isolation
Candidate source manifest frozen via tools/source_snapshot.py (.handoff/rounds/R01/candidate.json)
criteria_for_developer_round_r01.reviewer_gate_r01: Reviewer will independently verify snapshot SHA256, execute probes and independent adversarial negative controls in review/ workspace, and evaluate with review_gate.py before issuing verdict.
